claim_limit: At most an exposed-development Source positive-control screen of cohort/model-level headroom and an observable repair binding under one synthetic transient level excursion; not individual causal evidence, Capability, promotion, formal transfer, Target, or Query evidence.

configuration.clean_upper_bound_semantics: clean input values with center, scale, and target normalization all derived from the paired corrupt context to isolate input repair
configuration.excursion_bounds_rationale: M0 severe topology chosen before execution because width 64 is within the frozen public observer detectable width 40--96 and end 176 leaves 16 post points, satisfying its >=12 post-point requirement
configuration.excursion_scale_definition: 2.0 times the robust scale computed from the finite clean context before excursion injection, using the premise median/MAD fallbacks

development_gate.exact_definition: pass iff mean corrupt-minus-clean degradation is strictly positive in both datasets, mean corrupt-minus-repair gain is strictly positive in both datasets, and pooled repair harm rate is <=0.25

observer_binding_contract.activation_rule: call canonical repair only when all four public fields are finite, level score is positive, region satisfies 0<=start<end<=1, and estimated offset is nonzero; otherwise return identity
